title: primalucelib accepted calibration steps the controller refused in the parameter field
summary: The SESTO SENSO 3 protocol v1.0 reports a refusal in the field of the parameter ("Error: invalid parameter"); the library only recognised ERROR keys, so CAL_FOCUSER steps and the CAL_DIR write were taken as done whatever the field said, and refused moves and syncs ended ALERT without the reason.
evidence: 20261023132326-3447-primaluce-field-errors/verification.md (FND); protocol document v1.0 page 4; driver review against the document 2026-10-23

resolution.evidence: 20261023132326-3447-primaluce-field-errors/verification.md: primalucelib_reply_is_acknowledged() fails calibration steps, the CAL_DIR write, fine steps and the ARCO sync on any reply but done and keeps the text as the reason; refused moves and syncs show it; field_errors_refuse_calibration_requests and sestosenso3_field_errors pass and fail without the change; recorded run 66/66.
